spec_match.rationale: Sets real WebTransportDatagramDuplexStream knobs (incomingHighWaterMark, incomingMaxAge, outgoingMaxAge), sends real datagrams to an echo server and diffs stats.datagrams before/after.

interactive.rationale: Five numeric inputs, a read-echoes checkbox and a run button; before/after/delta table updates from real calls.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Blurb promises attributing loss to queue, max-age or network; delivered — not reading produced droppedIncoming +149..+196, reading produced no counter movement.

edge_cases.rationale: Absent counters shown as absent (expiredIncoming absent on Chrome 153); expiredOutgoing/lostOutgoing staying 0 explained as real results.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/5120203192139776 plus the exact spec anchors.

conformance.rationale: Feature-level suite (7 assertions: 6 script/typeof + 1 manual for the established-session shape). Flagged Chrome 153: 6/6 runnable pass; unflagged: all fail honestly.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Verified in headless Google Chrome for Testing 153.0.8010.12 via Playwright (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this environment) at desktop 1280x800 and mobile 360x740 DPR3 touch, both with --enable-blink-features=WebTransportStats (success path) and unflagged (honest unsupported branch). The success path ran against a real local Deno 2.9.8 QUIC/WebTransport echo server (https://127.0.0.1:4499/ with serverCertificateHashes) — not a simulation. The public default endpoint echo.webtransport.day:4433 is unreachable from this sandbox (QUIC blocked), so the out-of-the-box public path was only observed as a verbatim handshake failure. Not yet run on a real Chrome 160 build. No JS exceptions; the only console errors are Chrome's network-layer 'Failed to establish a connection to https://127.0.0.1:44443/never' lines from the conformance panel's intentional dead-endpoint assertions (plus deliberate failed connections in the edge experiments).

telemetry_health.rationale: showcaseTelemetry.assert on the primary action plus explicit unsupported and connect-failure branches; console logs are prefixed.

design_system.rationale: Only public/styles.css variables; button background overrides also set color; AA pairs (text-charcoal/bg-stone, text-black/bg-ivory, accent-emerald-dark and accent-rose on light backgrounds).

accessibility.rationale: Native controls, labels, visible focus, live regions; verified in the browser.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: All controls exercised at 1280x800 and 360x740 DPR3 touch; no horizontal overflow; tap targets >= 44px; screenshots read.

openQuestions.title: Re-verify on a real Chrome 160 build without flags
openQuestions.detail: Only Chrome 153 with --enable-blink-features=WebTransportStats was available. On Chrome 160 confirm getStats() is present unflagged and the member set (smoothedRtt, rttVariation, minRtt, estimatedSendRate, datagrams) matches.

openQuestions.title: expiredIncoming never appeared
openQuestions.detail: On Chrome 153 the expiredIncoming member was absent from every result even with incomingMaxAge set, although Chromium main's UpdateIncomingDatagramStats sets it. Check whether Chrome 160 reports it.

openQuestions.title: expiredOutgoing / lostOutgoing not provoked
openQuestions.detail: A loopback link never congests or loses; a throttled/lossy network (e.g. tc netem) is needed to show these counters move.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Native labelled controls with adequate touch targets and visible constraint hints.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Endpoint URL/hash inputs, selects, number inputs and checkboxes are native with <label for>, min-height 44px, inline hints.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Intrinsic grid layouts (auto-fit + minmax(min(100%, X), 1fr)) so panels reflow without horizontal overflow.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Endpoint fieldset, controls, readout cards use auto-fit/minmax(min(100%,...)); verified scrollWidth == clientWidth at 360px.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Landmarks, native semantics, accessible names, visible focus, polite live regions for async state.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: main/header/footer landmarks; async results in aria-live=polite output / role=status; :focus-visible outline on every control; first Tab reaches the crumb link.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Announce error outcomes programmatically, not only by colour.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Real errors (name + message) are written as text into live regions; colour is never the only signal.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Semantic table with caption/th scope, scrollable focusable region wrapper with an accessible name, container-query stacked layout on narrow widths with injected labels.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Tables sit in tabindex=0 role=region wrappers labelled by the caption; @container (max-width:560px) stacks rows into cards with data-label ::before labels; row headers are th scope=row.

summary: Real datagram bursts that show which stats.datagrams counter attributes the loss.
